ideas.pitch: A transparent supply chain tracking system that detects and flags hidden animal welfare violations using supplier telemetry and multi-modal audit logs.
ideas.title: InvisibleFootprint: Ethical Supply Chain Ledger for Mercy For Animals
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with Mercy For Animals' mission as a sponsor, targeting social impact and transparent auditing similar to the winning Vanderbilt Good Good Hackathon project.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent dashboard that surfaces hidden performance bottlenecks and dependency vulnerabilities across multi-repository student projects using custom graph traversal.
ideas.title: DevnovateLens: Automated Code Review and Architectural Vulnerability Mapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Devnovate sponsor ecosystem by solving a pain point familiar to student builders and judges alike—maintaining clean, scalable architectures under tight deadlines.

ideas.pitch: A platform built for CodeCrafters users that evaluates backend protocol implementations in real time and suggests hidden performance optimizations through differential testing.
ideas.title: CodeCrafted-CI: Gamified Code Refactoring and Automated Benchmark Runner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the CodeCrafters sponsor track, showcasing hard engineering and rigorous backend validation that appeals directly to technical judges.

ideas.pitch: An extension utilizing the Miro API to automatically transform disorganized brainstorming sticky notes into structured, executable system microservice diagrams.
ideas.title: MiroMind: Spatial AI Canvas for Collaborative System Architecture Mapping
ideas.why_it_could_win: Integrates deeply with the Miro sponsor API, capitalizing on the proven hackathon winning pattern of highlighting sponsor technology.

ideas.pitch: A predictive analytics tool that forecasts maintainer burnout and sudden project abandonment in open-source dependencies using statistical time-series models.
ideas.title: OSEN-Trace: Open Source Ecosystem Health and Contributor Risk Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Integrates with OSEN interests by predicting critical incident risks in public infrastructure, directly mirroring the Apart Research AI Forecasting winner.
